samples.question: Find the single round state-register disk: its colour declares the initial state (blue = OFF, orange = ON). A cluster of red dots rests tightly on and around this disk; every one of those red dots is a toggle that flips the state (OFF to ON, or ON to OFF). Red dots placed far away elsewhere on the canvas are decoys and do nothing. Apply every toggle in the disk's cluster to the initial state and read the final state. Does the tracked state finish ON? Answer yes or no.
